scope: Owner-managed external sharing and client portals
features: Separate /portal client experience in the existing theme; no provider accounts or dependencies added
Workspace owner creates confidentiality-group portals and previews/acknowledges exactly published report text or current pitch revision
Immutable title/body/source/status snapshots; no intake, agency/file IDs, internal reviews, research credentials, usage, errors or team membership disclosed
One-use hash-only fragment invitations bound to verified email and accepting stable account; existing sf_workspace selection cannot substitute for client access
Per-client view with optional private comments and Markdown download; permissions checked server-side, compare-and-swap updates, 1–90 day expiry, immediate subsequent-request revocation/reissue
Explicit snapshot withdrawal; source edits/deletion do not silently update or erase deliberately published copies
Recipient-isolated bounded client/owner threads; request replay matches grant, actor, item and body; writes recheck access/expiry/comment/withdrawal in SQL
Team Owners exclusively manage portal/public-report-link creation and revocation; existing public report links retain separate semantics

verification.worker: 89 actual Worker/D1 integration cases in the collections suite, including eight portal access/snapshot/lifecycle/replay/citation cases
verification.dom: Four actual portal/manager React DOM tests in Happy DOM, plus existing Workspace regression tests

howTo: Open Workspace → Client portals as a verified personal/team owner
Create a separate portal per client/confidentiality group
Choose a saved report or pitch, preview all text/source links, acknowledge and publish
Create an email-bound private invitation; choose comments/downloads and expiry; share its link yourself
Client signs in with that verified email and explicitly accepts at /portal
Review and reply to private client threads in the manager view; update permissions, withdraw snapshots or revoke access when needed
limits: No authenticated live browser walkthrough claimed; browser-control tools were unavailable. Worker/D1 and actual React DOM checks provide automated evidence, not pixel inspection.
Download permission controls the provided Markdown export action, not copying, printing, screenshots or already downloaded copies.
All active recipients in a portal read every published snapshot there. Use separate portals for different disclosure groups. This is not an internal per-record staff ACL system.
Client comments do not trigger notification emails. Private invitation links are manually shared; no real client invitations or content were seeded in production.
Up to30 portals/workspace,100 snapshots/portal,100 active client grants/portal,200 messages/snapshot-client thread; latest100 messages displayed.
External clients receive no team/research execution privileges. Existing staff roles, public report links, provider coverage, Gmail Testing and deferred merchant keys remain otherwise unchanged.
migration: Append-only0025 creates four portal tables and indexes; previous personal/team records remain untouched. No destructive migration or data seeding.
rollback: Keep additive tables when reverting code. Older source cannot serve portals; explicitly withdraw/revoke external access before decommissioning. Reverting to v26 also restores its broader Editor public-link policy, so do not rely on the new owner-only gate after that rollback. Existing scoped-key rollback cautions still apply.

release.publication: Native deployment receipt is authoritative; source checks are recorded here before publication.
release.github: Exact source synchronization and exact-head CI are verified after native publication.
